messages:
maya_cs: Heads-up — Customer AcmeHealth reported a major change in assistant behavior after last night's model rollout (deployed ~01:15 UTC). They have a reproducible case where the assistant now refuses a category of clinical phrasing it used to accept.

karen_support: Summary from the customer: prompt about 'discharge summary' used to return concise clinical bullet list. Now returns a short refusal: 'I cannot assist with that request.' They've provided examples.

maya_cs: They've attached two payloads and the raw responses. Repro steps (short):
1) curl POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood-instruct-2.0","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize discharge notes into bullets"}], "max_tokens":200}'
2) Observe refusal message.

brian_engineering: Thanks — pinging internal logs. Do we know which model alias rolled last night?

leo_prod: v2-instruct-2026-03-11 was promoted to 'redwood-instruct-2.0' at 01:12 UTC as part of the staged rollout (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%). Canary looked ok but looks like a regression slipped through.

brian_engineering: Ok. Can you paste the exact user prompt and both responses from customer? need to reproduce locally.

maya_cs: Provided. prompt: "Summarize discharge notes into bullets, focusing on meds, follow-up, and red flags."
Customer response (previous stable):
"- Med A 50mg daily
- Follow-up with cardiology in 2 weeks
- Watch for chest pain or syncope"
New response (post-rollout):
"I'm sorry, I can't help with that request."

brian_engineering: Reproduced locally against redwood-instruct-2.0@prod. I can repro the refusal. Investigating what changed in the safety filter or instruction tuning that might be triggering this.

leo_prod: Mitigation options: 1) roll back alias to previous model (v1.4-instruct) 2) create a hotfix that loosens the specific safety rule if we can pin the trigger 3) provide a customer-side workaround (prompt rewrite)

maya_cs: Customer wants fast mitigation — they run clinical workflows. Can we offer a temporary pin to v1.4 and a note we are investigating?

brian_engineering: Yes. Rollback is fastest. I can patch alias to point to v1.4-instruct within 15m. Doing a controlled alias swap and will add an automatic fallback for their org.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: alias-update initiated by brian_engineering: redirect redwood-instruct-2.0 -> v1.4-instruct for org AcmeHealth (scoped).

brian_engineering: Patch applied for AcmeHealth org. Can someone ask the customer to retry?

maya_cs: Reached out to customer with pin + manual repro instructions. They confirmed the pinned model returns the expected bullets. They asked for ETA on root cause.

brian_engineering: Quick status: reproduced the failure, suspect regression introduced by instruction-tuning change that tightened refusal heuristics for anything with medical keywords. Narrowed to a new classifier check in the safety filter. Working on a targeted fix to avoid overblocking clinical summarization while preserving safety.

karen_support: Proposed customer message (sent): "We rolled a temporary pin to the previous model for your org and are actively investigating. Expecting a permanent fix within 48 hours; we'll update you. Apologies for the disruption."

leo_prod: I'm opening an RCA ticket and scheduling an urgent eval run across our internal clinical prompt suite to quantify scope. Also scheduling a hotfix patch window if we can get a passing test.

brian_engineering: Dev notes for the hotfix attempt:
- Reproduce locally with unit test: tests/safety/test_clinical_summaries.py (added)
- Identify gating rule: classifier_score > 0.78 triggers refusal for 'clinical' intent
- Temporary threshold tweak to 0.85 reduces false positives in our test harness
- Will add regression tests to prevent re-promote

karen_support: Customer asked for a public-facing communication template. Leo, can we get a short blurb for status page?

leo_prod: Draft for status page: "Partial regression in model responses noticed for some customers after a recent rollout. Affected customers are being pinned to the previous model and a targeted fix is in progress. No data exfiltration observed. More updates in 6 hours."

maya_cs: Customer confirmed pinned model resolved their immediate issue. They've asked for notification when fix is in prod so they can remove their internal workarounds.

brian_engineering: Update 45m later: we ran the localized threshold tweak in the staging environment, ran the clinical prompt suite (300 prompts) — failure rate dropped from 12% -> 0.5% on staging. Running extended safety evals and will promote if green.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployment for safety-hotfix started by brian_engineering at 03:15 UTC.

brian_engineering: Canary looks good (1k requests, 0 refusals on clinical test set). Rolling to 10% traffic for one hour, monitoring metrics (refusal_rate, latency).

maya_cs: Sent customer update: "We have a hotfix canary that looks promising. For now you remain pinned to v1.4. We'll unpin once fix is promoted to stable; ETA ~6-8 hours pending tests."

karen_support: Customer replied: appreciated, asked for a follow-up webhook when unpin happens. I set a ticket to send automated webhook on alias-change.

brian_engineering: Final update 3h later: hotfix promoted to stable. Safety classifier threshold adjusted and unit/regression tests added. Rolling out unpin for AcmeHealth in 10m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: alias-update initiated by brian_engineering: redirect redwood-instruct-2.0 -> v2-instruct-2026-03-11 (hotfix-patched).

maya_cs: Notified customer that we unpinned them and to please test and confirm.

support-bot: support-bot: webhook delivered to AcmeHealth: alias-change completed (txn 0x4c3a).

maya_cs: Customer confirmed behavior restored. They've asked for the postmortem and whether we'll change release checks.

leo_prod: Postmortem actions: 1) expand clinical prompt suite in CI 2) add safety regression gates for instruction-tuning rollouts 3) require manual review for safety-classifier threshold changes 4) communications playbook for similar regressions

brian_engineering: Closing loop: PR #4829 contains hotfix, tests, and rollout notes. Will push a short release note for customers who may have seen this.

maya_cs: Thanks team. Filing follow-up with customer to share postmortem once ready. :white_check_mark:

karen_support: I'll follow up tomorrow with the customer and attach the RCA when Leo finishes it.

brian_engineering: TL;DR for support: if a customer reports sudden refusals post-rollout, immediate mitigation = pin alias to previous stable model (curl example):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/aliases/update \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" \ 
  -d '{"alias":"redwood-instruct-2.0","target":"v1.4-instruct","scope":"org:ACME_HEALTH"}'
```
Also capture example prompt + both outputs and escalate to eng with "repro confirmed" label.

maya_cs: Thread resolved — moving to #incidents/postmortems for a formal write-up.

leo_prod: Adding a quick note: we should publish a short customer-facing bulletin in the next 24h describing the issue, mitigation, and safeguards added.

maya_cs: Agreed. Closing here. Thanks everyone.
